name: huashu-mac-use
title_zh: 后台被遮挡的窗口也能截给你看
tagline_zh: 没有API的macOS原生app，照样能点、能截、能取证。窗口被挡住也能截。
tagline_en: Drive API-less macOS apps: click, capture occluded windows, probe automation, and control embedded Chromium via.
desc_en: 操控没有API的macOS原生app并留下可复现取证：截指定窗口（后台被遮挡也能截）、点击输入、探测某个app能不能自动化、内嵌Chromium的app走CDP零焦点操控、做产品实测与多模型跑批。浏览器里的事走huashu-chrome，翻旧截图走disk-keeper。
why_zh: 不靠辅助功能权限硬来，而是用系统底层截屏与事件注入，让被遮挡的后台窗口也能留下可复现的取证截图。
why_en: Bypasses Accessibility API limits with system-level capture and event injection, producing reproducible forensic screenshots of.
limit_zh: 只操控本机已安装的macOS原生app；不处理浏览器内网页（那归huashu-chrome）。
limit_en: Local macOS native apps only. No in-browser pages (huashu-chrome) or old screenshots (disk-keeper). Requires Screen Recording permission; target app.
title_en: Screenshot occluded macOS windows, even in background
